q: The Kleisli category of the Giry monad G on Meas has morphisms X → Y corresponding to:
opts: Markov kernels: measurable maps X → G(Y) (stochastic maps assigning a probability measure on Y to each x ∈ X)
exp: Kleisli category of Giry: morphisms are Markov kernels κ: X → G(Y) (x ↦ κ(x,·) a probability measure on Y). Composition is by Chapman-Kolmogorov. This makes the Kleisli category the natural framework for stochastic processes and Markov chains.
